Visioner BIG | 🇺🇦 🇷🇺 ‼️ ‼️ The damaged Russian cargo ship ASCALON is reportedly a sanctioned vessel used to transport weapons, ammunition, and military equipment for Russia’s Ministry of Defense, raising questions about the potential loss of a valuable military logistics shipment. ASCALON is a roll-on/roll-off cargo vessel equipped with two deck cranes, each capable of lifting 150 tons, and a dedicated deck for transporting wheeled and tracked military vehicles. The ship was reportedly sailing fully loaded from Kaliningrad to Benghazi, Libya. Its cargo may have included military equipment and vehicles intended for Russia’s Africa Corps, although the exact contents have not been confirmed. The vessel’s reported destination makes the incident particularly significant. Benghazi serves as an important logistics gateway for Russian operations in Africa, and disruption of military shipments along this route could complicate Moscow’s ability to sustain its overseas deployments. The strategic impact will depend on the extent of the damage and whether the suspected military cargo was actually aboard. See the latest updates with us: @visionergeo tweet
